description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_ConfigSchema, which manages configuration directives, their defaults, and schema serialization/deserialization for the HTMLPurifier library.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_ConfigSchema
classes.description: Class managing configuration schema, directives, and serialization for HTMLPurifier.

methods.name: makeFromSerial
methods.description: Unserializes and returns a ConfigSchema object from a stored serialized schema.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the configuration schema, optionally initializing it from a prototype or serial data.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Defines a new configuration directive with default value, type, and null allowance.

methods.name: addValueAliases
methods.description: Adds value aliases for a directive.

methods.name: addAllowedValues
methods.description: Sets allowed values for a directive.

methods.name: addAlias
methods.description: Creates a directive alias for backward compatibility.

methods.name: postProcess
methods.description: Replaces stdClass entries with type integers, adjusting for null allowances.
